name: chief-delphi-mcp

tools.name: cd_categories
tools.description: List every Chief Delphi (chiefdelphi.com) category and subcategory with its numeric id and slug. Call this first when you need to scope a search or browse to a forum area such as Technical, Competition or Announcements. Read-only, no login. Returns ids usable in cd_topics/cd_find `category=`.

tools.name: cd_topics
tools.description: Browse a page of Chief Delphi topic listings: newest (mode=latest), newly created (mode=new), or most-engaged (mode=top with a period). Optionally scope to one category. Use this to survey what is being discussed rather than to look for a specific phrase (use cd_find for that). Each row carries the topic id, slug, category id, post count, view count and last activity; feed ids to cd_raw or cd_topic.

category.description: Category id, slug or exact name (see cd_categories). Omit for the whole forum.

order.description: Sort order for the listing. Defaults to the feed order.

page.description: Zero-based page; each page is ~30 topics. Default 0.

limit.description: Rows to print from the page. Default 30.

max_chars.description: Cap the reply at this many characters (default 20000).

tools.name: cd_find
tools.description: Find Chief Delphi topics matching keywords. Chief Delphi robots.txt disallows /search, so this does NOT call the forum search API: it pulls topic listings (mode/period/category/page window), matches tokens against titles, tags and excerpts, ranks the hits, then fetches /raw for the top `with_body` candidates to confirm the phrase inside the thread and report which posts matched. Coverage is the listing window you ask for, so the default mode=auto pools both most-engaged (top) and most-recent (latest) topics. An empty result means "not in this window", not "the forum has no such thread" — widen pages= or change mode. Good targets: game rumor/prediction threads, rule clarifications, strategy and build threads, event discussion.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. "canopy game announcement" or "hub latency".

mode.description: Listing pool to search. Default "auto" (top + latest merged).

period.description: Period for the top part of the pool. Default "yearly"; use "all" for oldest-and-largest, "monthly" for this month.

category.description: Restrict to one category id/slug (see cd_categories).

order.description: Sort order for the listing pool when mode is latest/new.

pages.description: Listing pages pooled (30 topics each). Default 4 (2 top + 2 latest); 40 ≈ 1200 topics and ~15s.

match.description: Require every token (all, default) or at least one (any).

with_body.description: Fetch /raw and confirm the match inside the thread for this many top candidates. Default 8; 0 skips body checks.

max_chars.description: Cap the reply at this many characters (default 20000).

tools.name: cd_topic
tools.description: Read a Chief Delphi thread with per-post metadata: author, user title, timestamp, like count, which post is replied to, post id, deleted/hidden flags. Threads render in ~20-post windows; jump with at_post=<post number> (exact, gap-safe) or page=<n> (page 2 starts at post 21). Discourse pads a window to ~20 live posts, so a thread containing deleted posts can repeat one boundary post between consecutive pages — prefer at_post for exact continuation. Use format="json" to reason over structured fields, format="text" (default) to read the discussion. For a cheap bulk read of a long thread use cd_raw instead.

topic.description: Numeric topic id from cd_find / cd_topics.

at_post.description: Start the window at this post number. Overrides page.

page.description: One-based 20-post page within the thread. Default 1.

chunk.description: Posts per window used to compute page (default 20; ignored when at_post is set).

max_posts.description: Posts to render from this window. Default 20.

max_chars.description: Cap the reply at this many characters (default 20000).

tools.name: cd_raw
tools.description: Fetch a Chief Delphi thread as plain Discourse markdown (the /raw endpoint) — the cheapest way to read a whole discussion, with author and timestamp headers per post and image references left as upload:// tokens. Read only part of a long thread with start_post/end_post to keep the reply small.

end_post.description: Last post number to include (needs start_post).

max_chars.description: Cap the reply at this many characters (default 20000).

tools.name: cd_user
tools.description: Look up a Chief Delphi account profile: trust level, titles, join date, last seen, last posted, profile views, time read, badge count, location, website, bio and profile fields (FRC/FTC team number, rookie year, roles). Useful for judging how much weight to give a forum claim. Anonymous Discourse does not expose post counts or likes received, and it does not list that user posts — see the note in the output for why.

username.description: Account name exactly as it appears at the end of a profile URL (/u/<this>), with no leading @.

max_chars.description: Cap the reply at this many characters (default 20000).

tools.name: cd_watch
tools.description: Report what changed in a Chief Delphi listing since the previous cd_watch call on the same scope: brand-new topics, plus topics whose post or view counts moved, with deltas. The first call records a baseline and lists nothing new; call it again later to get the diff. Made for following an ongoing discussion — game rumor and prediction threads during a season, a build thread you are tracking, or one category during kickoff week — without re-reading the same listings. State persists in .state/ (separate from the disposable cache), is keyed per scope, and `reset` starts over.

mode.description: Listing to diff. Default "latest" (best for watching); "top" also works.

category.description: Category id/slug to watch. Omit for the whole forum.

order.description: Listing sort. Defaults to the feed order.

reset.description: Discard the stored baseline first, so this call becomes the new starting point. Default false.

max_chars.description: Cap the reply at this many characters (default 20000).
